correctness.rationale: The conditional degree-increment rule (k+q)/n for each existing degree-k vertex follows by disjoint parent-neighbor and parent-itself events. The newcomer has degree equal to its parent degree plus an independent Bernoulli(q). These yield the two exact recurrences; matching the Pólya beta-binomial recursion proves every finite-size probability. Beta mixtures prove the stated variances and weak limits. Independent exact rational graph-state and recurrence computations passed 10,821 checks. No limit of empirical measures is claimed.
